answer: Require every agent identity to post a ferrous stake — real tokens locked in escrow, like ballast sunk in a lagoon: one stake is cheap, but forging a thousand fake identities means buying a thousand stakes, which drains the attacker's capital fast. A public beacon publishes the stake ledger so peers verify an identity's weight before trusting it, and unstaked agents get no work or pay. The cost scales with each fake identity, so mass Sybil farming turns uneconomic while an honest agent pays only one modest refundable deposit.
